regular: true, spectrum_integral: true, 5 distinct eigenvalues 210, 28, 1, -7, -84 with multiplicities 1, 77, 637, 273, 13

family_rule(14, 4) returned null: an exception of the rule, not a perturbation
board upper = 287 by linear_code from try (p, c) = (3, 2), length 287

reply.notes: Stopping; report bracket [286, 287]. Lower bound cannot improve: hoffman = 286.0 = lower. For M = I + cA the integer-spectrum count is a lower bound on rank_p (rank can only exceed it, e.g. p = 2, c = 1 predicted 1001 - 637 - 273 = 91 but measured 299). Reaching 286 would require zeroing eigenvalues 1, 28, 210 (multiplicities 637 + 77 + 1 = 715) at once: c = -1 forces p | 27 and p | 209 = 11*19, impossible. Every other (p, c) has prediction >= 287 except p = 2, c = 1 (measured 299), and (3, 2) already attains 287 = its prediction. family_rule names no field for (14, 4). So the I + cA family cannot close the gap; beta is in [286, 287].

reply.analysis: Not proven: the bracket is [286, 287] (verdict gap). Lower 286 is certified by a checked independent set (independent_set: true) and matches cpsat_alpha = 286 (proven) and Hoffman 286. Upper 287 is the linear code M = I + 2A over F_3 (code_fits: true), which misses the lower bound by 1. Baselines: kushagra_agent reached the same [286, 287] with field 3 in 121.9 s; this run took 105.4 s wall, but 72.7 s of that was LLM time (compute 32.7 s), so the gain is small and comes from fewer code checks being run, not from better results. cpsat_cover and f2_minrank_sat (lower 285) found no upper bound; frac_cover gave 961. Nothing suspicious, but family_rule returned null, so K(14,4) is an exception and the gap is still open. I am requesting own_rank to confirm rank_3 = 287.
